problems.title: Domain of a variable-base logarithm
problems.question: Find the domain of $y=\log_{\sqrt{x-3}}((2x-2)/x)$.
problems.idea: Check the base as well as the argument.
steps: The square-root base must be positive, giving x>3.
The base must not equal 1, so x≠4.
For x>3 the argument 2-2/x is positive automatically.

problems.title: A base that is automatically greater than 1
problems.question: Solve $\log_{x+1/x}((3x-1)/x)\le0$.
problems.idea: First restrict x using the base.
formulas: For x>0, x+1/x≥2; log_bu≤0 with b>1 iff 0<u≤1.
steps: A positive base x+1/x requires x>0; for negative x it is negative.

problems.title: Compare a cylinder’s lateral area and base area
problems.question: A cylinder’s lateral area is twice its base area. Find h/r.
problems.idea: Substitute the standard area formulas.

problems.title: Unroll an equilateral cone
problems.question: A cone’s axial section is equilateral. Find the central angle of its unrolled lateral sector.
problems.idea: The sector arc is the base circumference.
steps: An equilateral axial triangle has side L equal to the base diameter 2r.

problems.title: Volume divided by sphere area
problems.question: A sphere’s volume-to-area numerical ratio is 2:3. Find its radius.
problems.idea: The common factors cancel.

problems.title: A standard exponential limit
problems.question: Find $\lim_{n\to\infty}(1+2/n)^{2n}$.
problems.idea: Match the exponent to the increment.
steps: The given expression is its square, so the limit is e⁴.
problems.answer: $e^4$; none of the five numerical choices.

problems.title: The last positive term of a decreasing sequence
problems.question: For aₙ=9-n/5, find the index of the smallest positive term.
problems.idea: The terms strictly decrease.
steps: Positive-index terms remain positive through n=44.
Therefore n=44 gives the smallest positive term.

problems.title: Clarify which base area is in the denominator
problems.question: A cylinder’s axial-section diagonal makes 60° with the base. Find the ratio of lateral area to the base-area sum.
problems.idea: The axial rectangle has width 2r.
formulas: tan60°=h/(2r); lateral area=2πrh; two bases have total area 2πr².
steps: The ratio to both bases together is (2πrh)/(2πr²)=h/r=2√3.
If only one base is intended, the ratio is 2h/r=4√3.
problems.answer: $2\sqrt3$ for both bases; $4\sqrt3$ for one base.
problems.note: The source wording uses a singular “base” with a sum of areas. Both interpretations are shown; both resulting values appear among the choices.

problems.title: Apply the recurrence one step at a time
problems.question: c₁=6 and cₙ₊₁=2cₙ-3n+2. Find c₄.
problems.idea: Use n=1,2,3 successively.

problems.title: Equal cone and cylinder measurements
problems.question: A cone and cylinder have equal heights, volumes and lateral areas. Find the cone generator’s inclination to its base.
problems.idea: Let R be the cone radius and r the cylinder radius.
formulas: Cone V=πR²h/3, lateral area=πRL; cylinder V=πr²h, lateral area=2πrh.
steps: Equal volumes give R=√3r. Equal lateral areas give RL=2rh.
Thus L/h=2/√3. The cone inclination θ satisfies sinθ=h/L=√3/2.

problems.title: Two perpendicular generators and unequal arcs
problems.question: Two perpendicular cone generators divide the base circumference in ratio 1:2. The height is 2√2. Find the lateral area.
problems.idea: The smaller central angle between their feet is 120°.
steps: Perpendicular generators give -R²/2+h²=0. Since h²=8, R²=16 and R=4.

problems.title: Limits of even and odd sums
problems.question: Find $\lim_{n\to\infty}(2+4+\cdots+2n)/(1+3+\cdots+(2n-1))$.
problems.idea: Replace the sums with formulas.
formulas: Sum of first n positive integers=n(n+1)/2; first n odd integers sum to n².
steps: The numerator is n(n+1); the denominator is n².

problems.title: Rationalize both root differences
problems.question: Find $\lim_{n\to\infty}\dfrac{\sqrt{n+3}-\sqrt{n+1}}{\sqrt{4n+3}-\sqrt{4n+1}}$.
problems.idea: Both differences have numerator 2 after rationalization.

problems.title: A telescoping reciprocal sum
problems.question: Find $\lim_{n\to\infty}\sum_{k=2}^{n+1}1/[k(k+1)]$.
problems.idea: Each term is a difference of adjacent reciprocals.
steps: The remaining reciprocal tends to zero.

problems.title: An infinite geometric sum
problems.question: Find the limit of 1/4+1/8+…+(1/4)(1/2)ⁿ⁻¹.
problems.idea: The common ratio has magnitude less than 1.
steps: As n grows, rⁿ tends to zero, so S∞=(1/4)/(1/2)=1/2.

problems.title: The first index beyond a threshold
problems.question: For xₙ=n²+10n, find the first index after which every term exceeds 1000.
problems.idea: This sequence increases for positive n.
steps: Since √1025≈32.016, n>27.016. The first integer is 28.

problems.title: Count integer-valued sequence terms
problems.question: How many positive integer terms occur in aₙ=(7n-1)/(n+7), n=1,2,…?
problems.idea: Rewrite the fraction as an integer minus a reciprocal.
steps: For aₙ to be an integer, n+7 must divide 50. Since n+7≥8, the possible divisors are 10,25,50.
They give n=3,18,43 and values 2,5,6, all positive.
No other divisor is at least 8.

problems.title: Count positive values by a sign chart
problems.question: How many terms of aₙ=(30.4-n)/(n²-200), n=1,2,…, are positive?
problems.idea: The numerator and denominator must have the same sign.
steps: For n≤14, the denominator is negative and numerator positive, so aₙ<0.
For 15≤n≤30 both are positive. For n≥31 the numerator is negative and denominator positive.
Exactly the indices 15 through 30 work, a total of 30-15+1=16.

problems.title: The alternating sign disappears inside absolute value
problems.question: For aₙ=(-1)ⁿ(2n-8), how many terms satisfy |aₙ|≤5?
problems.idea: The factor (-1)ⁿ has magnitude 1.

problems.title: Find a cylinder radius from an equal-area rhombus
problems.question: A cylinder is 16 cm high. Its base area equals that of a rhombus with diagonals 3 and 8 cm. Find its lateral area.
problems.idea: First equate the base areas.
formulas: Rhombus area=d₁d₂/2; πr²=base area; lateral area=2πrh.
problems.note: The printed choices use cm³, but surface area must use square centimetres.

problems.title: Add sphere areas, not radii
problems.question: Spheres have radii 3,4,12. Find the radius of a sphere whose surface area equals their total.
problems.idea: The common 4π cancels.
steps: Take the positive square root to get 13.

problems.title: Range of a logarithmic reciprocal
problems.question: Find the range of $15/[1+\lg(100+x^2)]-3$.
problems.idea: The logarithm has a minimum and no upper bound.
steps: Consequently 15/denominator ranges over (0,5], attaining 5 at x=0.

problems.title: Three mutually perpendicular cone generators
problems.question: Three cone generators of length 3 are pairwise perpendicular. Find the lateral area.
problems.idea: Their base endpoints form an equilateral triangle.
formulas: Distance between orthogonal vectors of length 3 is 3√2; equilateral circumradius=side/√3; cone area=πRL.
steps: Each pair of generator endpoints is 3√2 apart by Pythagoras.
Their equilateral triangle lies in the base circle, giving R=3√2/√3=√6.
The slant L is 3, so the lateral area is 3π√6.

problems.title: Use the angle of the unrolled sector
problems.question: A cone has lateral area 10π cm² and unrolled-sector angle 36°. Find the total surface area.
problems.idea: The sector angle gives the radius-to-slant ratio.
steps: From rL=10 and L=10r, obtain 10r²=10, so r²=1.
The base adds π cm² to the lateral 10π cm².

problems.title: Surface area after drilling through a cube
problems.question: A cylindrical hole of radius 1 cm passes through opposite face centres of a cube of edge 5 cm. Find the remaining surface area.
problems.idea: Remove the two circular openings and add the hole’s curved wall.
formulas: Cube area=6a²; removed disks=2πr²; hole wall=2πrh.
steps: The original cube area is 150 cm².
The openings remove 2π, while the length-5 hole adds 10π.
